condition_details.condition_dsl: result.recommended_drug is equal to ignore case "Levofloxacin"
result.recommended_drug is equal to ignore case "Amoxicillin"
result.recommended_drug is equal to ignore case "Cefuroxime"
medication.name is equal to ignore case "Coumadin" or medication.name is equal to ignore case "Warfarin"
condition_details.condition_postfix: medication.name "Coumadin" s==i { pop medication.name "Warfarin" s==i } over not if

condition_details.condition_dsl: medication.name is equal to ignore case "Theophylline"
medication.name is equal to ignore case "NSAID" or medication.name is equal to ignore case "Ibuprofen" or medication.name is equal to ignore case "Naproxen"
condition_details.condition_postfix: medication.name "NSAID" s==i { pop medication.name "Ibuprofen" s==i } over not if { pop medication.name "Naproxen" s==i } over not if

condition_details.condition_dsl: medication.name is equal to ignore case "Methotrexate"
medication.name is equal to ignore case "Probenecid"

action_details.action_dsl: add "Levofloxacin may potentiate the anticoagulant effect of warfarin/Coumadin, raising INR and bleeding risk. Monitor coagulation closely." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Levofloxacin may potentiate the anticoagulant effect of warfarin/Coumadin, raising INR and bleeding risk. Monitor coagulation closely." result.warnings swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "Levofloxacin may increase theophylline plasma levels; monitor for theophylline toxicity." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Levofloxacin may increase theophylline plasma levels; monitor for theophylline toxicity." result.warnings swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "Concomitant NSAIDs with Levofloxacin may increase the risk of CNS stimulation and seizures." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Concomitant NSAIDs with Levofloxacin may increase the risk of CNS stimulation and seizures." result.warnings swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "Amoxicillin may enhance the anticoagulant effect of warfarin/Coumadin; monitor INR." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Amoxicillin may enhance the anticoagulant effect of warfarin/Coumadin; monitor INR." result.warnings swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "Amoxicillin may reduce renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing methotrexate toxicity." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Amoxicillin may reduce renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing methotrexate toxicity." result.warnings swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "Probenecid reduces renal excretion of Cefuroxime, raising its plasma concentration." to result.warnings
action_details.action_postfix: "Probenecid reduces renal excretion of Cefuroxime, raising its plasma concentration." result.warnings swap addto
